verses.text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
lines: Surely God is good to Israel,
to those who are pure in heart.

verses.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
lines: But as for me, my feet were almost gone.
My steps had nearly slipped.

verses.text: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
lines: For I was envious of the arrogant,
when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.text: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
lines: For there are no struggles in their death,
but their strength is firm.

verses.text: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
lines: They are free from burdens of men,
neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.text: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
lines: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck.
Violence covers them like a garment.

verses.text: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
lines: Their eyes bulge with fat.
Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

verses.text: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
lines: They scoff and speak with malice.
In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

verses.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
lines: They have set their mouth in the heavens.
Their tongue walks through the earth.

verses.text: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
lines: Therefore their people return to them,
and they drink up waters of abundance.

verses.text: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
lines: They say, “How does God know?
Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

verses.text: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
lines: Behold, these are the wicked.
Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

verses.text: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
lines: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain,
and washed my hands in innocence,

verses.text: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
lines: For all day long I have been plagued,
and punished every morning.

verses.text: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
lines: If I had said, “I will speak thus”;
behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

verses.text: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me,
lines: When I tried to understand this,
it was too painful for me,

verses.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
lines: until I entered God’s sanctuary,
and considered their latter end.

verses.text: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
lines: Surely you set them in slippery places.
You throw them down to destruction.

verses.text: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
lines: How they are suddenly destroyed!
They are completely swept away with terrors.

verses.text: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
lines: As a dream when one wakes up,
so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

verses.text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
lines: For my soul was grieved.
I was embittered in my heart.

verses.text: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
lines: I was so senseless and ignorant.
I was a brute beast before you.

verses.text: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
lines: Nevertheless, I am continually with you.
You have held my right hand.

verses.text: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
lines: You will guide me with your counsel,
and afterward receive me to glory.

verses.text: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
lines: Whom do I have in heaven?
There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

verses.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
lines: My flesh and my heart fails,
but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.text: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
lines: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish.
You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

verses.text: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
lines: But it is good for me to come close to God.
I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge,
that I may tell of all your works.
